title: ‘Kerala @70’: Manorama News Conclave 2026 to explore state’s future in Kochi today
content: Kochi: The Manorama News Conclave 2026, a forum bringing together leading voices to discuss issues shaping the nation's future, will begin at 9 am on Saturday in Kochi. This year's conclave, themed 'Kerala @70', features a diverse line-up of speakers, including Union Civil Aviation Minister Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan, CPM General Secretary M A Baby and Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan. Launched in 2017, the Manorama News Conclave has explored themes ranging from happiness and freedom to the idea of a new India. The day-long forum brings together political leaders, experts, artists and other prominent voices for conversations and debates on issues of contemporary relevance. Here's a quick look at the sessions lined up for this year's conclave: 9 am | Inauguration Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Union Minister for Civil Aviation 10 am | Turbulence and Takeoff: Indian Aviation — From Disruption to Transformation Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Hibi Eden MP 10.15 am | Generation Unscripted: Dreams, Disruptions and the New Language of Success Gouri Kishan, Raul John Aju, Fathima Tahiliya | Mariya Jomon 11 am | The Real Left: Who Speaks for Progressive Politics in India Today? M A Baby, General Secretary, CPM | A Ayyappadas 11.45 am | Kerala on the Edge: Lessons, Preparedness and the Climate Challenge Dr S Abhilash, C K Vishnudas | Binu Aravindan 12.30 pm | Growth with Purpose: ESG and the New Rules of Responsible Business M P Ahammed, Chairman, Malabar Group | Prasanth R Nair 2 pm | The Art of Speaking Truth Dr Edanad Rajan Nambiar, Chakyarkoothu exponent 2.45 pm | Growth and Ground Realities: Building the Next Keralam P K Kunhalikutty, Jose Thomas, Vinod S Kumar, Tom M Joseph | Shani Prabhakaran 3.45 pm | Oceans of Influence: Why the Oceans Will Shape India's Future Admiral Krishna Swaminathan, Chief of the Naval Staff | Nisha Purushothaman 4.45 pm | What Happened to Keralam? How Kerala's Society, Values and Aspirations Have Changed Ramesh Pisharody, Vinoy Thomas, Adeela Abdulla | Jayamohan 5.30 pm | The Urvashi Effect: How an Actor Transcended Generations, Genres and Expectations Urvashi 6 pm | Valedictory Address: The Next Kerala — Rethinking Kerala's Future in a Changing India V D Satheesan, Chief Minister | Johny Lukose
